study_design: Single-center, randomized, open-label trial with blinded outcome adjudication; modified intention-to-treat analysis
outcome_definition: AKI based solely on serum creatinine, defined as meeting at least one stage 1 criterion from AKIN, RIFLE, or KDIGO; baseline was the most recent serum creatinine measurement before surgery. The publication explicitly states that urine output was not included.
source_location: Pages 3-4, Study Outcomes and Primary Outcomes sections; page 7, Table 2; page 8, Study Strengths and Limitations
extraction_note: Empagliflozin 25 mg daily plus standard care versus standard care alone. Table 2 reports RR 0.57; the raw randomized arm counts were also extracted. Although the endpoint combined three classification systems, all were implemented using serum-creatinine criteria only.

study_label: Snel et al. randomized pilot study (2025)
study_design: Single-center, open-label, phase IV randomized controlled pilot study; intention-to-treat analysis
outcome_definition: Any AKI according to KDIGO 2012 serum-creatinine criteria, with creatinine evaluated separately from urine output: increase of at least 0.3 mg/dL within 48 hours, at least 1.5 times baseline within 7 days, stage 2 increase of 2.0-2.9 times baseline, or stage 3 creatinine/kidney replacement therapy criterion.
source_location: Supplementary Table 1, KDIGO definition and staging; Supplementary Table 3, Creatinine—Any row
extraction_note: Empagliflozin 10 mg daily from 3 days before surgery through postoperative day 2 versus standard care. The supplementary table explicitly separates creatinine-only AKI from urine-output and combined KDIGO AKI. No RR or CI for the creatinine-only comparison was reported, so only raw event/total data were extracted.

study_design: Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial; primary intention-to-treat analysis with post hoc creatinine-only analysis
outcome_definition: AKI defined exclusively by KDIGO serum-creatinine criteria: increase of at least 0.3 mg/dL (26.5 μmol/L) within 48 hours or at least 1.5-fold from baseline within 7 days; urine-output criteria excluded.
extraction_note: Dapagliflozin 10 mg beginning the day before surgery and continued through postoperative day 2 versus placebo. This post hoc analysis explicitly isolated AKI defined exclusively by serum-creatinine criteria and reported both raw counts and an unadjusted RR with 95% CI.
